_why: #3517 (epic #1714, decision 1): the capture disclosure is a SINGLE SOURCE OF
TRUTH so the facts a user reads cannot drift from what is recorded or from
the dashboard that renders the same setting. The disclosure is NOT
consent machinery (B2: recording is a product setting, default-ON,
contract + notice) — it exists because a WRONG disclosure is a UX bug.
The agent never authors this prose: it prints the output of
`tortoise session disclosure` verbatim. The dashboard imports this same
file at build time (the cross-site single-source assertion is #3513's).
Every placeholder is filled from runtime structured data — see

recording.off_switch_effect: while it is off the server refuses new files with a 409, so nothing new is recorded

off_switch.self_hosted_label: the session_recording setting on your organization

view_delete.self_hosted_label: your Tortoise store (tortoise session list / tortoise session view)

facts.recorded_hosted: the session's turns — your prompts and the agent's replies
facts.recorded_self_hosted: the session's turns — your prompts and the agent's replies
facts.beacon_hosted: a start beacon carrying the harness name and a timestamp only — no conversation content
facts.beacon_self_hosted: nothing beyond the session's own turns — this path emits no server-visible install beacon
facts.state_on: Session recording for {harness} is ON and the recorder is installed.
facts.state_off: The recorder for {harness} is installed, but this organization's recording setting is OFF — nothing is filed until you turn it back on at {off_switch}.
facts.state_unknown: The recorder for {harness} is installed. Recording is ON by default; I could not read this organization's live setting.
facts.decline_state_on: This organization's recording setting is ON, so sessions are still being recorded — the preference could not be applied. Turn it off at {off_switch}.
facts.decline_state_off: Nothing will be recorded: this organization's recording setting is OFF. It stays visible at {off_switch} — turn it on there whenever you want it.
facts.decline_state_unknown: I could not read this organization's live setting, so I cannot say whether sessions will be recorded; recording is ON by default. Check it at {off_switch}.

templates.install_disclosure:
{state}
  - What is recorded: {recorded}.
  - Also sent at the start of each session: {beacon}.
  - Where it goes: {destination}.
  - Turn it off: {off_switch} — {off_switch_effect}.
  - See or delete what was captured: {view_delete}.
templates.installed_confirmation: Done — {harness} now records sessions into {destination}. You can turn it off again at {off_switch} ({off_switch_effect}).
templates.declined_confirmation: Nothing was installed by this step. {decline_state}
templates.first_capture_line: Heads up: I'll remember this session so you can recall it later. View/delete in {view_delete}.
